extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and store listing

extDescription.message: A TOTP authenticator that lives in your browser. Scan a QR code from any page, then fill your one-time codes with a single click.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the store listing

popupEmptyHint.message: Add one by scanning a QR code on the page, or by entering a secret manually.

addDialogSecretHint.message: Base32 string from the 2FA setup page

errSecretCharset.message: Secret must be Base32 (letters A–Z and digits 2–7).

errSecretTooShort.message: Secret is too short. Did you copy the whole thing?

rowMore.description: Open the row menu for binding and other actions

rowMenuBindExact.description: Bind only this exact host (no subdomains)

rowMenuBindRegistrable.description: Bind the registrable domain so subdomains also match

rowMenuBindShared.description: Shared hosting domain — only exact match for safety

rowMenuUnbind.description: Remove the binding for this host

rowMenuUnbindTitle.description: Tooltip for unbind action on a previously-bound domain

rowMenuNoHost.message: Open a web page first to bind this site.
rowMenuNoHost.description: Shown in the row menu when no current tab host is available

rowMenuNoCandidates.description: Shown in the row menu when the host is already in the account's bindings

optionsBindingsTitle.description: Title of the settings page section for managing domain bindings

optionsBindingsSubtitle.message: Accounts bound to a domain rise to the top of the popup on that domain. Shared-hosting domains (like github.io) match only exactly.

optionsBindingsEmpty.message: No bindings yet. Use the ⋯ menu on a popup row to bind the current site.

optionsPanelSubtitle.message: When you focus an OTP input, a panel appears below it with the codes bound to the current site.

optionsPanelEnabled.message: Show the panel on OTP input fields

optionsBroadDetection.message: Also recognize inputs by keywords (验证码, OTP, verification code…)

optionsDisabledHosts.message: Never show the panel on these sites
